scope: Research-only source-access, payload recovery, QC and prioritization evidence for Jubilee Model Research & Calibration.

current_wqp_depth_audit.interpretation: The current WQP corpus is useful for shoreline/watershed context but cannot be treated as a robust bottom-oxygen or vertical-stratification panel. ADEM beach rows are 91.6% missing depth and Alabama Water Watch Magnolia rows are 100% missing depth.

actual_payload_recovery.guardrail: Meaher is an upper-bay proxy for Daphne forcing, not direct Eastern Shore bottom oxygen. Native depth still requires deployment-geometry interpretation before bottom-state eligibility.
Bon Secour is a regional lower-bay/tributary proxy, not direct Point Clear/Daphne bottom oxygen.

actual_payload_recovery.qc_note: Hydro quality-flag columns are null in this sample, so it is retained as access/schema evidence and is not promoted as QC-good oxygen evidence.

actual_payload_recovery.period_utc: 2019-01-01 00:30 through 2019-07-03 13:10, with an approximately 84.8-day spring data gap
actual_payload_recovery.qc: All 4409 temperature, salinity and dissolved-oxygen rows have source flag 3; water-height has 4403 flag-3 and 6 flag-1 rows.
actual_payload_recovery.important_correction: The delivered hydro file contains one station/time series with pressure and water height but no explicit observation-depth column or repeated vertical dimension. NCEI metadata describes hydrography at different depths, but this file alone does not support a vertical-gradient/stratification feature. Deployment/instrument geometry must be recovered before such use.

actual_payload_recovery.time_encoding_issue: NetCDF time is encoded as days since 0000-01-00 00:00:00 CDT; generic CF num2date rejects day zero. Research normalization must explicitly document/validate the intended datenum conversion before canonical temporal joins.
actual_payload_recovery.important_correction: The NetCDF DO variable is percent saturation, not mg/L. Do not silently treat these values as concentration or compare directly to mg/L hypoxia thresholds.
actual_payload_recovery.research_value: This is now actual dense summer in-bay oxygen/salinity/temperature/depth evidence rather than a metadata-only lead. It is high priority for mechanism testing after time/deployment semantics are finalized.

observed_current_validation_access.ncei_0211052_focal_awac: Archive resolved; contains observed u/v/w current data in 0.5 m bins at 20-minute output cadence. A visible Dump_rep.dat payload is approximately 87 MB. Payload not yet normalized in this run.
observed_current_validation_access.ncei_0248354_focal_2007_2016: Archive root resolved; deeper nested payload inventory still required.
observed_current_validation_access.griidc_mobile_bay_ship_channel_ctd_adcp_: Metadata-verified candidate retained ahead of large HFR because it is in-bay and mechanism-matched.
observed_current_validation_access.hfr: Retained as secondary validation after direct in-bay/FOCAL currents because of lower information-per-byte and weaker spatial match to Eastern Shore Jubilee transport.

source_qc_semantics.effect: Bad/suspect rows can now be excluded explicitly instead of relying on numeric plausibility alone.

revised_ingestion_priority: 1. Finish canonical normalization and time/deployment validation of NCEI 0188979; it is now downloaded and schema-audited.
2. Recover Middle Bay 2019 deployment/depth metadata so the 4409 QC-good rows can be classified correctly; do not invent a vertical gradient from the current single series.
3. Normalize observed currents from FOCAL AWAC 0211052 and compare directly with NGOFS2 direction/magnitude/phase before any transport-weight promotion.
4. Inventory/ingest FOCAL 0248354 co-located current+hydrography and Mobile Bay ship-channel CTD+ADCP 2010.
5. Expand native ARCOS station-year history with QC flags and deployment geometry, especially Meaher/Middle Bay where relevant.
6. Use NCEI 0116496 1989-1999 profiles for long physical-state climatology and matched-control context.
7. Ingest large HFR archives only after the smaller direct-current datasets establish the validation design.
remaining_blockers: No direct Point Clear/Daphne bottom dissolved-oxygen observation is available for live production.
Zero verified matched clean controls remain; held-out forecast skill and incremental discrimination are not established.
No 2016 or 2019 canonical Jubilee positive is presently available for direct event-aligned scoring of the recovered 0188979/0224293 payloads.
Middle Bay 2019 vertical/deployment geometry is not encoded in the delivered hydro file; stratification promotion remains blocked.
NCEI 0188979 time encoding requires explicit validated datenum normalization, and its DO variable is percent saturation rather than mg/L.
Observed-current versus NGOFS2 validation has not yet been scored; no model transport weight change is justified.
